build_pairwise_model_from_config: build a PairwiseModel instance from a config object and tensorizers dictionary
create_pairwise_model_embeddings: create embedding modules for paired text inputs using the _create_embeddings class method
encode_relations_pairwise: encode pairwise relations by computing absolute difference and elementwise product of representations
run_pairwise_model_forward: run the forward pass on a pair of text inputs through the PairwiseModel
save_pairwise_model_modules: save the PairwiseModel representation modules to disk with optional base path and suffix
